Integrate a passive airflow channel (e.g., a chimney effect) so the fan can be omitted or powered by a small solar‑thermal turbine.
Add a removable, insulated back panel that stores excess heat for night‑time drying, differentiating from purely instantaneous heating.

data.plain_summary: You’ve found that several existing solar dryers already use a solar absorber plate, a fan, and a mesh surface to dry food, so the core idea isn’t new. What sets yours apart is the ultra‑simple black tin sheet and the fact you want it to run without any electricity at all. To make it stand out, consider adding a selective‑coating absorber, a passive chimney‑type airflow, or a heat‑storage back panel. Those tweaks will give you a clearer inventive edge over the closest prior art.
data.original_idea_text: एक सौर ऊर्जा से चलने वाला फसल सुखाने का यंत्र, जिसमें काले रंग की टिन की चादर हवा को गर्म करती है और एक छोटा पंखा गर्म हवा को जाली वाली ट्रे के ऊपर से गुज़ारता है, ताकि किसान टमाटर और मिर्च बिना बिजली के सुखा सकें।

localized.plain_summary: आपने पाया कि कई मौजूदा सौर ड्रायर पहले से ही सौर एब्जॉर्बर प्लेट, पंखा और जाल सतह का उपयोग करके भोजन को सुखाते हैं, इसलिए मूल विचार नया नहीं है। आपका विचार अलग इसलिए है क्योंकि इसमें अत्यंत सरल काली टिन शीट है और आप इसे पूरी तरह से बिना बिजली के चलाना चाहते हैं। इसे अलग दिखाने के लिए, एक चयनात्मक‑कोटिंग एब्जॉर्बर, एक निष्क्रिय चिमनी‑प्रकार वायु प्रवाह, या एक हीट‑स्टोरेज बैक पैनल जोड़ने पर विचार करें। ये बदलाव आपको सबसे निकटतम पूर्व कला की तुलना में स्पष्ट आविष्कारात्मक लाभ देंगे।
differentiation_suggestions: सरल काली टिन शीट को एक पैटर्नयुक्त चयनात्मक‑कोटिंग एब्जॉर्बर से बदलें जो तापमान बढ़ाए जबकि वजन कम रखे।
एक निष्क्रिय वायु प्रवाह चैनल (जैसे चिमनी प्रभाव) को एकीकृत करें ताकि पंखा को हटाया जा सके या छोटे सौर‑थर्मल टरबाइन द्वारा चलाया जा सके।
एक हटाने योग्य, इन्सुलेटेड बैक पैनल जोड़ें जो अतिरिक्त गर्मी को रात‑समय में सुखाने के लिए संग्रहीत करे, जिससे केवल तत्काल गर्मी वाले मौजूदा डिज़ाइन से अंतर बनता है।

sections.text: The utility model discloses a mobile solar drying device, which comprises a photovoltaic power generation unit, a solar drying unit and a solar energy storage unit, wherein the photovoltaic power generation unit consists of a photovoltaic panel, a photovoltaic controller, a storage battery and an inverter; the drying unit is used for drying the materials in the drying chamber by utilizing solar heat; the heat collection unit comprises a heat collection manifold and a plurality of heat collection vacuum tubes, the heat collection manifold is communicated with the plurality of heat collection vacuum tubes, and the heat collection vacuum tubes heat the gas led into the tubes and then convey the gas to the drying unit; the mobile unit comprises a supporting plate, a plurality of idler wheels suitable for moving are arranged below the supporting plate, and the photovoltaic power generation unit, the drying unit and the heat collection unit are all fixed on the upper surface of the supporting plate. The utility model discloses a portable solar drying device has realized solar energy and has united dry all-weather operation, to different weather, different illumination intensity carries out the automatic switch-over of different drying pattern, and is convenient for remove.

examined_documents.title: Greenhouse heat-storage type solar hot-wind drying device for grains
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: A greenhouse heat-storage type solar hot-wind drying device for grains belongs to a utilization technology of renewable energy. An underground heat storage tank is arranged under the ground surface inside a greenhouse drying room; a solar-air heat collector is arranged at the upper part outside the greenhouse drying room; an automatic controller, a blower, a hot wind discharge pipe, a hot wind delivery pipe and a cold air returning pipe are arranged in the greenhouse drying room; two ends of the hot wind delivery pipe with a suction fan and a third valve are respectively communicated with the solar-air heat collector and the underground heat storage tank; two ends of the cold air returning pipe with a first valve are respectively connected on the solar-air heat collector and the underground heat storage tank; two ends of the hot wind discharge pipe with a second valve are respectively communicated with the hot wind delivery pipe and the cold air returning pipe; an exhaust outlet is arranged on the wall of the greenhouse drying room; and the automatic controller is connected with the suction fan, the blower, the first valve, the second valve and the third valve respectively by leads. The greenhouse heat-storage type solar hot-wind drying device fully utilizes solar energy as drying energy and has the characteristics of being simple in structure, low in operation cost and excellent in environment-friendly effect.

examined_documents.title: Solar tea dryer
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The utility model relates to an agricultural product stoving technical field, concretely relates to solar energy tealeaves drying-machine. The drying machine comprises a shell and a transmission device, wherein a rotatable drying roller is arranged in the shell, a spiral guide piece is arranged in the drying roller, one end of the drying roller is provided with a feed inlet, the other end of the drying roller is provided with a discharge outlet, the upper part of the drying roller is provided with a moisture discharging barrel, the bottom of the drying roller is installed on a support frame, a heating bin is arranged below the support frame, a grid plate is arranged between the heating bin and the drying roller, the heating bin is connected with a solar hot air device through an air guide pipe, and heat exchange holes are. The utility model provides a current tealeaves drying-machine at the high problem of stoving in-process energy consumption, and dry evenly, work efficiency is high. The utility model discloses a set up solar hot-air system, use solar energy heated air, provide the hot-blast as the stoving heat source, saved a large amount of electric energy, energy saving and emission reduction's effect is showing to the stoving cost has been reduced.

Claim 1: 1. The utility model provides a solar energy tealeaves drying-machine, includes casing (1) and transmission (5), is provided with rotatable drying drum (2) in casing (1), be provided with spiral guide piece (12) in drying drum (2), drying drum (2) one end is provided with feed inlet (10), and the other end is provided with discharge gate (11), its characterized in that: the drying device is characterized in that a dehumidification barrel (3) is arranged at the upper part of the drying roller (2), the bottom of the dehumidification barrel is arranged on a support frame (7), a heating bin (8) is arranged below the support frame (7), a grid plate (9) is arranged between the heating bin (8) and the drying roller (2), the heating bin (8) is connected with a solar hot air device (6) through an air guide pipe (14), and heat exchange holes (23) are densely distributed in the surface of the wall of the drying roller (2).

Claim 2: 2. The solar tea dryer of claim 1, wherein: the solar hot air device comprises a heat-insulating cylinder (61) arranged on a support plate (62) and a plurality of vacuum heat-collecting tubes (63) arranged on the support plate (62) side by side, heat-conducting rods (64) are arranged in the vacuum heat-collecting tubes (63), the heat-insulating cylinder (61) comprises an outer heat-insulating shell (611), an inner container (612), an air-guiding heat-exchanging tube (613) penetrating through the inner container (612) and a plurality of heat-exchanging sleeves (616), and the front ends of the heat-exchanging sleeves (616) are welded with the outer wall of the inner container (612) into a whole; the tail end of each vacuum heat collecting pipe (63) is fixed on the support plate (62), and the opening end of each vacuum heat collecting pipe is fixedly connected with a corresponding heat exchange sleeve (616) in an inserting way through a heat conducting rod (64); one end of the air guide heat exchange tube (613) is provided with an air inlet (614), and the other end of the air guide heat exchange tube is provided with an air outlet (615).

Claim 3: 3. The solar tea dryer according to claim 1 or 2, characterized in that: the front end of the drying roller (2) is provided with a conical roller head (21), the tail end of the drying roller is provided with a rotating shaft (24), the wall of the drying roller (2) is provided with a circular guide rail (22), and the support frame (7) is provided with a roller (13) matched with the circular guide rail (22).

Claim 4: 4. The solar tea dryer of claim 3, wherein: the transmission device (5) comprises a driving motor (51) for driving the small belt wheel (52) to rotate, a large belt wheel (53) and a transmission belt connected between the belt wheels, wherein the large belt wheel (53) is connected with the rotating shaft (24).

Claim 5: 5. The solar tea dryer of claim 1, wherein: and a strong exhaust fan (4) is arranged in the moisture exhaust cylinder (3).

Claim 6: 6. The solar tea dryer of claim 1, wherein: and a far infrared heater (15) is arranged in the heating bin (8).

examined_documents.title: An improved solar dryer with enhanced efficiency of drying
examined_documents.text:
Abstract: The present invention provides an improved solar dryer with improved. The dryer consists of a solar absorber/collector (9) and a drying chamber (6). One end of the collector is connected to a forced draft fan (10) and the other end connects the drying chamber. The drying chamber has a drawer in which the material to be dried is kept on a wire mesh. The dryer further has the provision for placing color indicative silica gel under the wire mesh when operated in recirculation mode. The other end of the drying chamber has an induced draft fan (11). Both the dc fans operate using a 10 watt photovoltaic panel (3). V- trough reflectors (4,5,7,8) made from anodized aluminum are fixed on the collector and optionally on the drying chamber. A tracking circuit is incorporated to auto -track the dryer. A locking mechanism (14) is also incorporated to help the unit withstand high wind load. The dryer further has the provision of programmable recirculation of the spent air from drying chamber once its humidity drops below a pre -set value which process helps to speed up the rate of drying.

Claim 1: 1.一种具有提高了的干燥效率的改进型太阳能干燥器，包括：干燥腔（06）和太阳能收集器/吸收器（09），所述干燥腔和所述太阳能收集器/吸收器相互连接并通过用于自动锁定和跟踪的旋转轴（2）和锁定销（14）放置在公共基座（01）上；其中，所述干燥腔由抽屉和干燥剂组成，所述抽屉具有用于放置待干燥物品的金属丝网，所述干燥剂放置在位于所述金属丝网下方的金属托盘（23）中以干燥所述待干燥物品，所述收集器/吸收器由金属板和双层玻璃组成以便吸收太阳日射并加热经过所述收集器/吸收器的空气流；多个风机（10和11），所述风机连接至所述收集器/吸收器的入口处和所述太阳能干燥腔的出口处以诱导空气对流通过隔热管（12），所述隔热管将所述收集器/吸收器的端部与所述干燥腔的端部连接，所述风机由设置在所述太阳能干燥器后侧的一个或多个光伏PV板（3）供电，所述风机的速度可选地由多个调节器（15和16）调节；多个反射器（7和8），所述反射器附接在所述收集器/吸收器上以提高日射量和干燥空气温度；另外的多个反射器（4和5），所述另外的多个反射器附接在所述干燥腔上以促进干燥；电磁阀（13），所述电磁阀附接在所述隔热管的各端部并由可编程湿度控制器和湿度传感器控制；以及显示板（17）。

Claim 2: 2.如权利要求1所述的改进型太阳能干燥器，其中，所述干燥器的容量在0.5-1.0kg湿质量范围内。

Claim 3: 3.如权利要求1所述的改进太阳能干燥器，其中，所述收集器/吸收器相对于水平面在20-26°的范围内倾斜。

Claim 4: 4.如权利要求1所述的改进型太阳能干燥器，其中，附接在所述收集器/吸收器上的所述反射器使所述日射量提高了40-50%并使干燥空气温度提高了10-20℃。

Claim 5: 5.如权利要求1所述的改进型太阳能干燥器，其中，附接在所述干燥腔上的所述反射器在直接干燥期间提高了日射量，并且所述反射器可选地能用于盖住所述干燥腔从而将直接式太阳能干燥器转换为间接式太阳能干燥器。

Claim 6: 6.权利要求1所述的改进型太阳能干燥器，其中，所述PV板用于向所述风机、自动跟踪电路和湿度控制器供电。

section.label: Abstract
section.text: The utility model discloses a mobile solar drying device, which comprises a photovoltaic power generation unit, a solar drying unit and a solar energy storage unit, wherein the photovoltaic power generation unit consists of a photovoltaic panel, a photovoltaic controller, a storage battery and an inverter; the drying unit is used for drying the materials in the drying chamber by utilizing solar heat; the heat collection unit comprises a heat collection manifold and a plurality of heat collection vacuum tubes, the heat collection manifold is communicated with the plurality of heat collection vacuum tubes, and the heat collection vacuum tubes heat the gas led into the tubes and then convey the gas to the drying unit; the mobile unit comprises a supporting plate, a plurality of idler wheels suitable for moving are arranged below the supporting plate, and the photovoltaic power generation unit, the drying unit and the heat collection unit are all fixed on the upper surface of the supporting plate. The utility model discloses a portable solar drying device has realized solar energy and has united dry all-weather operation, to different weather, different illumination intensity carries out the automatic switch-over of different drying pattern, and is convenient for remove.

evidence.title: Greenhouse heat-storage type solar hot-wind drying device for grains
evidence.quote: solar-air heat collector is arranged at the upper part outside the greenhouse drying room

section.label: Abstract
section.text: A greenhouse heat-storage type solar hot-wind drying device for grains belongs to a utilization technology of renewable energy. An underground heat storage tank is arranged under the ground surface inside a greenhouse drying room; a solar-air heat collector is arranged at the upper part outside the greenhouse drying room; an automatic controller, a blower, a hot wind discharge pipe, a hot wind delivery pipe and a cold air returning pipe are arranged in the greenhouse drying room; two ends of the hot wind delivery pipe with a suction fan and a third valve are respectively communicated with the solar-air heat collector and the underground heat storage tank; two ends of the cold air returning pipe with a first valve are respectively connected on the solar-air heat collector and the underground heat storage tank; two ends of the hot wind discharge pipe with a second valve are respectively communicated with the hot wind delivery pipe and the cold air returning pipe; an exhaust outlet is arranged on the wall of the greenhouse drying room; and the automatic controller is connected with the suction fan, the blower, the first valve, the second valve and the third valve respectively by leads. The greenhouse heat-storage type solar hot-wind drying device fully utilizes solar energy as drying energy and has the characteristics of being simple in structure, low in operation cost and excellent in environment-friendly effect.

evidence.quote: the heating bin is connected with a solar hot air device through an air guide pipe

section.label: Abstract
section.text: The utility model relates to an agricultural product stoving technical field, concretely relates to solar energy tealeaves drying-machine. The drying machine comprises a shell and a transmission device, wherein a rotatable drying roller is arranged in the shell, a spiral guide piece is arranged in the drying roller, one end of the drying roller is provided with a feed inlet, the other end of the drying roller is provided with a discharge outlet, the upper part of the drying roller is provided with a moisture discharging barrel, the bottom of the drying roller is installed on a support frame, a heating bin is arranged below the support frame, a grid plate is arranged between the heating bin and the drying roller, the heating bin is connected with a solar hot air device through an air guide pipe, and heat exchange holes are. The utility model provides a current tealeaves drying-machine at the high problem of stoving in-process energy consumption, and dry evenly, work efficiency is high. The utility model discloses a set up solar hot-air system, use solar energy heated air, provide the hot-blast as the stoving heat source, saved a large amount of electric energy, energy saving and emission reduction's effect is showing to the stoving cost has been reduced.
